entries.snippet: test.skip(!controlled && browserName !== "chromium", "SW sem controle fora do Chromium — gate de device real (Safari/Firefox).");
entries.reason: Engine limitation, not an app condition. RC2.3.9 split the old unconditional skip: on every Chromium project (chromium, mobile-chrome, tablet-portrait, tablet-landscape, reduced-motion) the test now ASSERTS navigator.serviceWorker.controller after reload (expect(controlled).toBe(true)), so a PWA/precache regression fails. This skip can only fire when browserName !== 'chromium' AND the SW did not take control: Playwright documents service-worker support as Chromium-only, and WebKit/Gecko offline takeover is a real-device gate (Safari/Firefox). Evidence: `playwright test e2e/mobile-device.spec.ts -g offline --project=chromium --project=mobile-chrome --project=tablet-portrait --project=tablet-landscape --project=reduced-motion` passes (SW takes control, not skipped); the webkit/firefox engines are not installed in this sandbox, so non-Chromium takeover could not be exercised here.
